correctness.rationale: The tetrahedral surface is the quotient of a triangular period-two flat torus by inversion. Four explicit displacement bisectors trap the source Voronoi cell in a cyclic isosceles trapezoid; by inversion symmetry the actual fundamental Voronoi cell has area sqrt(3), exactly equal to the candidate trapezoid, which proves exhaustiveness for all s in [0,1/6]. Nonoverlapping circular caps give the exact distribution. Symbolic polynomial integration yields mass 1, E[D^2]=1/3 and E[D^4]=(1+12s^2)(5-36s^2)/30; the maximum distance is circumradius sqrt(1+12s^2). Reproducible CHECK.py confirms exact symbolic equalities plus sampled torus-image and distribution tests; samples do not replace proof.

A continuous 12-branch nontrivial plateau of its mean, with explicitly and strictly changing fourth moment and eccentricity, is a structural contrast among natural metric invariants.
